description: In any fixed first-order language, no theory has precisely all the structures with finite nonempty domains as its models.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Compactness.finitude_not_axiomatizable.{u, v} (L : FirstOrder.Language) :
  ¬∃ T, ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) (x : L.Structure M), Nonempty M → (M ⊨ T ↔ Finite M)
